narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>A quarter of three hundred sixty is one hundred eighty, because I took half of it.
<bookmark mark='four'/>Lay four slices of one hundred eighty degrees round the circle. They go round the cake twice.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Four equal quarters must fill the cake exactly once, so each quarter is smaller.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A quarter turn is one quarter of a full turn, and also half of a half turn.
